rig_note: Both fighters share the humanoid profile (GeneralSkeleton, facing +Z, +X the fighter's left, T-pose rest, each bone's +Y toward its child). Keys are sized on the Hunter; the hips track is written over the skeleton's motion scale so it fits the Rogue.
weapon_note: The weapon stays fixed to the hand bone (FighterRig.fix_weapons()); its blade lies along the right hand's local +X, so a key aims it with the hand's "blade" direction.
